```{r}

dir.create('/users/k1806347/oliverpainfel/Analyses/genodisc_validation/config/', recursive = T)

library(data.table)

####
# Create gwas_list
####

gwas_list <- NULL

gwas_list_scz <- rbind(
  gwas_list,
  data.table(
    name = 'SCZ',
    path = '/users/k1806347/oliverpainfel/Data/GWAS_sumstats/GenoFuncPipe_paper/SCZ/SCZ.original.gz',
    population = 'EUR',
    n = NA,
    sampling = NA,
    prevalence = NA,
    mean = NA,
    sd = NA,
    label = 'SCZ'))

write.table(gwas_list_scz, '/users/k1806347/oliverpainfel/Analyses/genodisc_validation/config/gwas_list_scz.txt', row.names = F)

gwas_list <- NULL

gwas_list_cad <- rbind(
  gwas_list,
  data.table(
    name = 'CAD',
    path = '/users/k1806347/oliverpainfel/Data/GWAS_sumstats/GenoFuncPipe_paper/CAD/GCST90132314.h.tsv.gz',
    population = 'EUR',
    n = NA,
    sampling = NA,
    prevalence = NA,
    mean = NA,
    sd = NA,
    label = 'CAD'))

write.table(gwas_list_cad, '/users/k1806347/oliverpainfel/Analyses/genodisc_validation/config/gwas_list_cad.txt', row.names = F)

####
# Create config file
####

config_scz <- c(
  "outdir: /users/k1806347/oliverpainfel/Analyses/genodisc_validation/output", 
  "config_file: /users/k1806347/oliverpainfel/Analyses/genodisc_validation/config/config_scz.yaml", 
  "gwas_list: /users/k1806347/oliverpainfel/Analyses/genodisc_validation/config/gwas_list_scz.txt", 
  "ldsc: T", 
  "magma_gene: T", 
  "magma_drugtargetor: T",
  "twas_panel_psychencode: T",

  "gtex_weights: ['Whole_Blood']", 
  "non_gtex_weights: ['CMC.BRAIN.RNASEQ']", 
  "twas_gsea_drugtargetor: T"
)

write.table(config_scz, '/users/k1806347/oliverpainfel/Analyses/genodisc_validation/config/config_scz.yaml', col.names=F, row.names=F, quote=F)

config_cad <- c(
  "outdir: /users/k1806347/oliverpainfel/Analyses/genodisc_validation/output_cad",

)

write.table(config_cad, '/users/k1806347/oliverpainfel/Analyses/genodisc_validation/config/config_cad.yaml', col.names=F, row.names=F, quote=F)
```
